entries.title: Streets of Rogue
entries.definitive_edition: Streets of Rogue on Windows PC with Character Pack DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Current PC release with Character Pack DLC
primary.why: The PC release has the full game, the Character Pack DLC route, and the best update/capture/input flexibility. Console ports are valid and broadly content-complete, but PC remains the best archive version.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Streets of Rogue on Steam or GOG for Windows PC and add the Character Pack DLC if you want the complete current content route.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release with Character Pack DLC available.
